local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local DATASTORE_NAME = "FlyHigh_PlayerData_v1"
local playerDataStore = nil

local success, err = pcall(function()
	playerDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(DATASTORE_NAME)
end)
if not success then
	warn("[DataManager] DataStoreService unavailable, running in offline/mock mode:", err)
end

local sessionData = {}

local function createLeaderstats(player, maxAltitude, summitCount)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local rekorVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rekorVal.Name = "Rekor (km)"
	rekorVal.Value = maxAltitude
	rekorVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local puncakVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
	puncakVal.Name = "Puncak"
	puncakVal.Value = summitCount
	puncakVal.Parent = leaderstats

	return leaderstats
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local defaultData = {
		MaxAltitude = 0,
		SummitCount = 0,
		EmergencyKits = 0,
	}

	local loadedData = defaultData
	if playerDataStore then
		local getSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return playerDataStore:GetAsync("User_" .. userId)
		end)
		if getSuccess and type(result) == "table" then
			loadedData.MaxAltitude = result.MaxAltitude or 0
			loadedData.SummitCount = result.SummitCount or 0
			loadedData.EmergencyKits = result.EmergencyKits or 0
		elseif not getSuccess then
			warn("[DataManager] Failed to load data for player " .. player.Name .. ":", result)
		end
	end

	sessionData[userId] = loadedData

	-- Set Attributes for client accessibility
	player:SetAttribute("MaxAltitude", loadedData.MaxAltitude)
	player:SetAttribute("SummitCount", loadedData.SummitCount)
	player:SetAttribute("EmergencyKits", loadedData.EmergencyKits)

	createLeaderstats(player, loadedData.MaxAltitude, loadedData.SummitCount)
end

local function savePlayerData(player)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local data = sessionData[userId]
	if not data or not playerDataStore then return end

	local saveSuccess, err = pcall(function()
		playerDataStore:SetAsync("User_" .. userId, data)
	end)
	if not saveSuccess then
		warn("[DataManager] Failed to save data for player " .. player.Name .. ":", err)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	savePlayerData(player)
	sessionData[player.UserId] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		savePlayerData(player)
	end
end)

-- Public API for other server scripts
local DataManager = {}

function DataManager.UpdateAltitude(player, altitudeKm)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local data = sessionData[userId]
	if not data then return end

	if altitudeKm > data.MaxAltitude then
		data.MaxAltitude = math.floor(altitudeKm)
		player:SetAttribute("MaxAltitude", data.MaxAltitude)

		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Rekor (km)") then
			leaderstats["Rekor (km)"].Value = data.MaxAltitude
		end
	end
end

function DataManager.AddSummit(player)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local data = sessionData[userId]
	if not data then return end

	data.SummitCount = (data.SummitCount or 0) + 1
	data.MaxAltitude = 10000
	player:SetAttribute("SummitCount", data.SummitCount)
	player:SetAttribute("MaxAltitude", 10000)

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		if leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Puncak") then
			leaderstats.Puncak.Value = data.SummitCount
		end
		if leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Rekor (km)") then
			leaderstats["Rekor (km)"].Value = 10000
		end
	end
	savePlayerData(player)
end

function DataManager.ModifyEmergencyKits(player, delta)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local data = sessionData[userId]
	if not data then return false end

	local current = data.EmergencyKits or 0
	if current + delta >= 0 then
		data.EmergencyKits = current + delta
		player:SetAttribute("EmergencyKits", data.EmergencyKits)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

_G.FlyHighDataManager = DataManager

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function formatAltitude(km)
	km = km or 0
	return string.format("%d km", math.floor(km))
end

local function updateOverheadTitle(player, billboard)
	local titleLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("TitleLabel")
	local masterLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("MasterLabel")
	if not titleLabel then return end

	local maxAltitude = player:GetAttribute("MaxAltitude") or 0
	local summitCount = player:GetAttribute("SummitCount") or 0
	local isMaster = player:GetAttribute("IsMaster") or false

	if masterLabel then
		masterLabel.Visible = isMaster
	end

	if summitCount > 0 then
		titleLabel.Text = string.format("[⭐ Puncak: %dx]", summitCount)
		titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) -- Gold
		titleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(139, 90, 0)
	else
		titleLabel.Text = string.format("[Rekor: %s]", formatAltitude(maxAltitude))
		titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255) -- Cyan
		titleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 60, 100)
	end
end

local function setupOverheadGui(player, character)
	local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	if not head then return end

	-- Remove existing overhead if any
	local oldGui = head:FindFirstChild("OverheadGui")
	if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "OverheadGui"
	billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 65)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Parent = head

	-- Master Crown Label
	local masterLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	masterLabel.Name = "MasterLabel"
	masterLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
	masterLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	masterLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	masterLabel.Text = "👑 PARTY MASTER"
	masterLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 50)
	masterLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	masterLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 0)
	masterLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	masterLabel.TextSize = 14
	masterLabel.Visible = false
	masterLabel.Parent = billboard

	-- Title Label (Rekor or Puncak)
	local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
	titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 16)
	titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	titleLabel.Text = "[Memuat Rekor...]"
	titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255)
	titleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	titleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 40, 70)
	titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	titleLabel.TextSize = 15
	titleLabel.Parent = billboard

	-- Name Label
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = string.format("%s (@%s)", player.DisplayName, player.Name)
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextSize = 13
	nameLabel.Parent = billboard

	-- Initial update
	updateOverheadTitle(player, billboard)

	-- Listen for attribute changes
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MaxAltitude"):Connect(function()
		updateOverheadTitle(player, billboard)
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SummitCount"):Connect(function()
		updateOverheadTitle(player, billboard)
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsMaster"):Connect(function()
		updateOverheadTitle(player, billboard)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		setupOverheadGui(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		setupOverheadGui(player, player.Character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local FlyHighConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FlyHigh"):WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("FlyHighConfig"))

local lobbyFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("FlyHighLobby")
local podsFolder = lobbyFolder:WaitForChild("MatchmakingPods")

local podStates = {}

for _, podModel in ipairs(podsFolder:GetChildren()) do
	if podModel:IsA("Model") then
		local floorPad = podModel:WaitForChild("FloorPad")
		local console = podModel:WaitForChild("Console")
		local prompt = console:WaitForChild("StartPrompt")
		local statusGui = console:WaitForChild("StatusGui")

		podStates[podModel.Name] = {
			model = podModel,
			pad = floorPad,
			console = console,
			prompt = prompt,
			statusGui = statusGui,
			players = {},
			master = nil,
			isStarting = false,
		}
	end
end

local function updatePodVisuals(podData)
	local statusGui = podData.statusGui
	local countLabel = statusGui:FindFirstChild("CountLabel")
	local masterInfo = statusGui:FindFirstChild("MasterInfo")
	local statusLabel = statusGui:FindFirstChild("StatusLabel")

	local playerCount = #podData.players
	if countLabel then
		countLabel.Text = string.format("Pemain: %d / %d", playerCount, FlyHighConfig.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_POD)
		if playerCount == FlyHighConfig.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_POD then
			countLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
		else
			countLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)
		end
	end

	if masterInfo then
		if podData.master then
			masterInfo.Text = string.format("Master: 👑 %s", podData.master.DisplayName)
		else
			masterInfo.Text = "Master: (Kosong)"
		end
	end

	if statusLabel then
		if podData.isStarting then
			statusLabel.Text = "Status: 🚀 BERSIAP TERBANG..."
			statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
		elseif playerCount > 0 then
			statusLabel.Text = "Status: Menunggu Master Mulai"
			statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 200)
		else
			statusLabel.Text = "Status: Menunggu Pemain"
			statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 240)
		end
	end

	-- Adjust pad glow color
	if podData.isStarting then
		podData.pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
	elseif playerCount > 0 then
		podData.pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 120)
	else
		podData.pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
	end
end

local function getPlayersOnPad(padPart)
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	
	local characters = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character then
			table.insert(characters, p.Character)
		end
	end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters

	-- Check a region extending above the pad
	local padPos = padPart.Position
	local padSize = padPart.Size + Vector3.new(2, 10, 2)
	local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(padPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)), padSize, overlapParams)

	local foundPlayers = {}
	local added = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		local char = part.Parent
		if char and char:IsA("Model") then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			if player and not added[player] then
				added[player] = true
				table.insert(foundPlayers, player)
				if #foundPlayers >= FlyHighConfig.MAX_PLAYERS_PER_POD then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return foundPlayers
end

local function startFlightSequence(podData)
	if podData.isStarting then return end

	-- Ensure we have up-to-date players
	local currentPlayers = getPlayersOnPad(podData.pad)
	if #currentPlayers == 0 and podData.master then
		currentPlayers = { podData.master }
	end
	if #currentPlayers == 0 then return end

	podData.isStarting = true
	podData.prompt.Enabled = false
	podData.players = currentPlayers

	local statusLabel = podData.statusGui:FindFirstChild("StatusLabel")
	for i = FlyHighConfig.COUNTDOWN_DURATION, 1, -1 do
		if statusLabel then
			statusLabel.Text = string.format("Meluncur dalam %d detik...", i)
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end

	if statusLabel then
		statusLabel.Text = "🎈 LEPAS LANDAS!"
	end

	-- Trigger Balloon Spawner Service
	if _G.FlyHighBalloonManager and _G.FlyHighBalloonManager.LaunchBalloon then
		_G.FlyHighBalloonManager.LaunchBalloon(podData.players, podData.master, podData.pad.Position)
	else
		warn("[PodManager] _G.FlyHighBalloonManager not ready!")
	end

	task.wait(2)
	podData.players = {}
	podData.master = nil
	podData.isStarting = false
	podData.prompt.Enabled = true
	updatePodVisuals(podData)
end

-- Hook Proximity Prompts
for podName, podData in pairs(podStates) do
	podData.prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if podData.isStarting then return end

		local currentOnPad = getPlayersOnPad(podData.pad)
		local playerIsOnPad = false
		for _, p in ipairs(currentOnPad) do
			if p == player then playerIsOnPad = true break end
		end

		-- If not detected on pad (e.g. standing near console edge), treat as on pad if interacting
		if not playerIsOnPad then
			table.insert(currentOnPad, player)
			playerIsOnPad = true
		end

		podData.players = currentOnPad

		-- Master logic
		if not podData.master then
			podData.master = player
		end

		if player == podData.master then
			startFlightSequence(podData)
		else
			-- Check if current master is still here
			local masterPresent = false
			for _, p in ipairs(currentOnPad) do
				if p == podData.master then masterPresent = true break end
			end

			if not masterPresent then
				podData.master = player
				startFlightSequence(podData)
			else
				local statusLabel = podData.statusGui:FindFirstChild("StatusLabel")
				if statusLabel then
					statusLabel.Text = string.format("Hanya Master (%s) yang bisa mulai!", podData.master.DisplayName)
					task.delay(2, function()
						updatePodVisuals(podData)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Main detection loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.3)
		for podName, podData in pairs(podStates) do
			if not podData.isStarting then
				local currentPlayers = getPlayersOnPad(podData.pad)
				
				-- Check for changes
				local previousMaster = podData.master
				podData.players = currentPlayers

				-- Assign Master
				if #currentPlayers > 0 then
					local masterStillPresent = false
					for _, p in ipairs(currentPlayers) do
						if p == previousMaster then
							masterStillPresent = true
							break
						end
					end

					if not masterStillPresent then
						podData.master = currentPlayers[1]
					end
				else
					podData.master = nil
				end

				-- Update player attributes
				for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local inThisPod = false
					for _, inP in ipairs(currentPlayers) do
						if inP == p then
							inThisPod = true
							break
						end
					end

					if inThisPod then
						p:SetAttribute("CurrentPod", podName)
						p:SetAttribute("IsMaster", (p == podData.master))
					elseif p:GetAttribute("CurrentPod") == podName then
						p:SetAttribute("CurrentPod", nil)
						p:SetAttribute("IsMaster", false)
					end
				end

				updatePodVisuals(podData)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local FlyHighConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FlyHigh"):WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("FlyHighConfig"))
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FlyHigh"):WaitForChild("Remotes")
local templates = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FlyHigh"):WaitForChild("Templates")

local pilotControlEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("PilotControlEvent")
local emergencyKitEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("EmergencyKitEvent")
local flightSyncEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("FlightStateSyncEvent")
local hazardAlertEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("HazardAlertEvent")

local activeFlights = {}

local BalloonManager = {}
_G.FlyHighBalloonManager = BalloonManager
BalloonManager.activeFlights = activeFlights

function BalloonManager.LaunchBalloon(players, master, spawnPos)
	local balloonTemplate = templates:WaitForChild("HotAirBalloon")
	local balloon = balloonTemplate:Clone()
	balloon.Name = "Balloon_" .. (master and master.Name or "Team")
	
	-- Start position: use pod pad position if provided, else default
	local startPos = spawnPos and (spawnPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)) or Vector3.new(0, 12.5, -20)
	balloon:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPos))
	balloon.Parent = Workspace

	local root = balloon.PrimaryPart
	local alignPos = root:WaitForChild("AlignPosition")
	local alignOri = root:WaitForChild("AlignOrientation")
	local burnerFlame = balloon:WaitForChild("Burner"):WaitForChild("BurnerFlame")
	local burnerLight = balloon:WaitForChild("Burner"):WaitForChild("BurnerLight")
	local siren = balloon:WaitForChild("EmergencySiren")
	local sirenLight = siren:WaitForChild("SirenLight")

	-- Match alignment immediately to startPos to prevent any physics jerk
	alignPos.Position = startPos
	alignOri.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos)

	local groundLevelY = startPos.Y

	local flightData = {
		balloon = balloon,
		root = root,
		alignPos = alignPos,
		alignOri = alignOri,
		burnerFlame = burnerFlame,
		burnerLight = burnerLight,
		siren = siren,
		sirenLight = sirenLight,
		groundY = groundLevelY,
		players = players,
		master = master,
		pilot = nil,
		pilotSteer = Vector3.zero,
		isGasActive = false,
		altitudeKm = 0,
		hasLiftedOff = false,
		holes = 0,
		invulnTime = 0,
		isFreefalling = false,
		isGameOver = false,
		isVictory = false,
		tetheredPlayers = {},
		usedKits = {},
		targetPosition = startPos,
	}

	-- Teleport players directly into basket standing on the floor
	for i, player in ipairs(players) do
		player:SetAttribute("UsedEmergencyKitThisFlight", false)
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				local offset = Vector3.new((i - 2) * 2.5, 3.5, 0)
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos + offset)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Hook Pilot Seat & HelmPrompt
	local helm = balloon:WaitForChild("HelmSeat")
	local helmPrompt = helm:WaitForChild("HelmPrompt")

	helmPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and not helm.Occupant then
			helm:Sit(hum)
		end
	end)

	helm:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
		local occupant = helm.Occupant
		if occupant and occupant.Parent then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent)
			flightData.pilot = player
			helmPrompt.Enabled = false
		else
			flightData.pilot = nil
			flightData.pilotSteer = Vector3.zero
			helmPrompt.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	-- Setup Weapon Racks (Pistol or AK47)
	if _G.FlyHighWeaponManager and _G.FlyHighWeaponManager.SetupWeaponRacks then
		local masterBoughtAK = master and (master:GetAttribute("BoughtAK47") == true) or false
		_G.FlyHighWeaponManager.SetupWeaponRacks(balloon, masterBoughtAK)
	end

	-- Setup Tethers & Repair Prompts immediately
	if _G.FlyHighTetherManager and _G.FlyHighTetherManager.SetupBalloonTethers then
		balloon:SetAttribute("TethersSetup", true)
		_G.FlyHighTetherManager.SetupBalloonTethers(balloon, #players)
	end

	table.insert(activeFlights, flightData)

	balloon.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not balloon:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
			for idx, fd in ipairs(activeFlights) do
				if fd == flightData then
					table.remove(activeFlights, idx)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	return flightData
end

function BalloonManager.ApplyPuncture(flightData)
	if flightData.invulnTime > 0 or flightData.holes >= FlyHighConfig.MAX_HOLES or flightData.isGameOver then
		return false
	end

	flightData.holes = math.min(flightData.holes + 1, FlyHighConfig.MAX_HOLES)
	flightData.invulnTime = FlyHighConfig.PASSIVE_INVULN_DURATION

	local holeSlots = flightData.balloon:FindFirstChild("HoleSlots")
	if holeSlots then
		local holePart = holeSlots:FindFirstChild("Hole" .. flightData.holes)
		if holePart then
			holePart.Transparency = 0
			local prompt = holePart:FindFirstChild("PatchPrompt")
			if prompt then prompt.Enabled = true end
		end
	end

	if flightData.holes >= FlyHighConfig.MAX_HOLES then
		flightData.isFreefalling = true
	end

	return true
end

function BalloonManager.RepairHole(flightData, holeNumber)
	if flightData.holes <= 0 then return end
	local holeSlots = flightData.balloon:FindFirstChild("HoleSlots")
	if holeSlots then
		local holePart = holeSlots:FindFirstChild("Hole" .. (holeNumber or flightData.holes))
		if holePart then
			holePart.Transparency = 1
			local prompt = holePart:FindFirstChild("PatchPrompt")
			if prompt then prompt.Enabled = false end
		end
	end

	flightData.holes = math.max(0, flightData.holes - 1)
	if flightData.holes < FlyHighConfig.MAX_HOLES then
		flightData.isFreefalling = false
	end
end

-- Emergency Repair Trigger with Anti-Waste Cooldown
emergencyKitEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	for _, flightData in ipairs(activeFlights) do
		local isCrew = false
		for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
			if p == player then isCrew = true break end
		end

		if isCrew then
			if flightData.usedKits[player.UserId] then
				return
			end

			-- Anti-Waste check: Reject if team shield is already running
			if flightData.invulnTime > 0 then
				return
			end

			local success = false
			if _G.FlyHighDataManager then
				success = _G.FlyHighDataManager.ModifyEmergencyKits(player, -1)
			else
				success = true
			end

			if success then
				flightData.usedKits[player.UserId] = true
				player:SetAttribute("UsedEmergencyKitThisFlight", true)

				-- Clutch save & full restore!
				flightData.holes = 0
				flightData.isFreefalling = false
				flightData.invulnTime = FlyHighConfig.CLUTCH_SAVE_INVULN_DURATION

				local holeSlots = flightData.balloon:FindFirstChild("HoleSlots")
				if holeSlots then
					for _, h in ipairs(holeSlots:GetChildren()) do
						h.Transparency = 1
						local p = h:FindFirstChild("PatchPrompt")
						if p then p.Enabled = false end
					end
				end
			end
			break
		end
	end
end)

-- Pilot Control Input Event
pilotControlEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, steerVec, gasActive)
	for _, flightData in ipairs(activeFlights) do
		if flightData.pilot == player then
			flightData.pilotSteer = steerVec or Vector3.zero
			flightData.isGasActive = (gasActive == true)
			break

-- Heartbeat Physics and State Loop
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for _, flightData in ipairs(activeFlights) do
		if not flightData.isGameOver and not flightData.isVictory then
			-- Decrement invulnerability
			if flightData.invulnTime > 0 then
				flightData.invulnTime = math.max(0, flightData.invulnTime - dt)
				local flash = (math.floor(flightData.invulnTime * 8) % 2 == 0)
				flightData.sirenLight.Brightness = flash and 4 or 0
			else
				flightData.sirenLight.Brightness = 0
			end

			-- Check Condition 2: Total Crew Wipe (All players died)
			local livingCrewCount = 0
			for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
				if p.Character then
					local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
						livingCrewCount = livingCrewCount + 1
					end
				end
			end

			if livingCrewCount == 0 and #flightData.players > 0 then
				flightData.isGameOver = true
				print("[BalloonManager] Game Over: Total Crew Wipe!")
				task.delay(4, function()
					if flightData.balloon then flightData.balloon:Destroy() end
				end)
			end

			-- Calculate Vertical & Horizontal speeds
			local holeConfig = FlyHighConfig.HOLE_EFFECTS[flightData.holes] or FlyHighConfig.HOLE_EFFECTS[0]
			local baseVerticalSpeedKmS = (FlyHighConfig.MAX_ALTITUDE_KM / FlyHighConfig.BASE_FLIGHT_DURATION_SEC) -- ~16.67 km/s

			local deltaAltitudeKm = 0
			local visualYDelta = 0

			if flightData.holes == 5 then
				-- Rapid freefall
				deltaAltitudeKm = -baseVerticalSpeedKmS * 3.5 * dt
				visualYDelta = -80 * dt
			elseif flightData.isGasActive then
				-- Burning Gas
				flightData.burnerFlame.Size = 14
				flightData.burnerLight.Brightness = 5
				if holeConfig.can_ascend then
					deltaAltitudeKm = baseVerticalSpeedKmS * holeConfig.ascend_rate * dt
					visualYDelta = 25 * dt
				elseif flightData.holes == 2 then
					deltaAltitudeKm = 0
					visualYDelta = 0
				else
					deltaAltitudeKm = -baseVerticalSpeedKmS * 0.5 * dt
					visualYDelta = -12 * dt
				end
			else
				-- Gas Inactive (Descending towards ground)
				flightData.burnerFlame.Size = 6
				flightData.burnerLight.Brightness = 2
				if flightData.targetPosition.Y > flightData.groundY then
					deltaAltitudeKm = -baseVerticalSpeedKmS * 0.4 * holeConfig.descend_mult * dt
					visualYDelta = -18 * holeConfig.descend_mult * dt
				else
					deltaAltitudeKm = 0
					visualYDelta = 0
				end
			end

			flightData.altitudeKm = math.clamp(flightData.altitudeKm + deltaAltitudeKm, 0, FlyHighConfig.MAX_ALTITUDE_KM)
			if flightData.altitudeKm >= 50 then
				flightData.hasLiftedOff = true
			end

			-- Update data records for all crew members
			if _G.FlyHighDataManager then
				for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
					_G.FlyHighDataManager.UpdateAltitude(p, flightData.altitudeKm)
				end
			end

			-- Check Victory
			if flightData.altitudeKm >= FlyHighConfig.MAX_ALTITUDE_KM and not flightData.isVictory then
				flightData.isVictory = true
				flightData.targetPosition = Vector3.new(0, 2515, 2070)
				flightData.alignPos.Position = flightData.targetPosition

				if _G.FlyHighDataManager then
					for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
						_G.FlyHighDataManager.AddSummit(p)
					end
				end
				print("[BalloonManager] Team docked at the Cloud Palace 10,000 km!")
			end

			-- Check Condition 1: Ground Crash
			if flightData.holes == 5 and flightData.hasLiftedOff and flightData.altitudeKm <= 0 then
				flightData.isGameOver = true
				print("[BalloonManager] Balloon crashed! Game Over.")
				for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
					if p.Character then
						local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Horizontal steering movement
			local steerX = flightData.pilotSteer.X
			local steerZ = flightData.pilotSteer.Z
			local horizontalSpeed = 30 * dt

			local newY = math.max(flightData.groundY, flightData.targetPosition.Y + visualYDelta)
			flightData.targetPosition = Vector3.new(
				flightData.targetPosition.X + steerX * horizontalSpeed,
				newY,
				flightData.targetPosition.Z + steerZ * horizontalSpeed
			)
			flightData.alignPos.Position = flightData.targetPosition

			-- Dynamic tilt calculation
			local tiltZ = -steerX * 0.08
			local tiltX = steerZ * 0.08
			flightData.alignOri.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(tiltX, 0, tiltZ)

			-- Broadcast sync event to crew (throttled at 10 Hz)
			if (os.clock() - (flightData.lastSyncTime or 0)) >= 0.1 then
				flightData.lastSyncTime = os.clock()
				for _, p in ipairs(flightData.players) do
					flightSyncEvent:FireClient(p, {
						altitudeKm = flightData.altitudeKm,
						holes = flightData.holes,
						invulnTime = flightData.invulnTime,
						isGasActive = flightData.isGasActive,
						isFreefalling = flightData.isFreefalling,
						usedEmergencyKit = flightData.usedKits[p.UserId] or false,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

			end
		end
	end

				elseif (os.clock() - obs.spawnTime) > 15 then

	local char = localPlayer.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
	local isSeatedInHelm = (seat ~= nil and seat.Name == "HelmSeat")

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveZ = moveZ - 1 end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveZ = moveZ + 1 end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveX = moveX - 1 end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveX = moveX + 1 end

		steerVector = Vector3.new(moveX, 0, moveZ)

		local now = os.clock()
		local stateChanged = (steerVector ~= lastSentSteer) or (isGasHeld ~= lastSentGas)

			pilotControlEvent:FireServer(steerVector, isGasHeld)

			lastSendTime = now
		end

		isGasHeld = false
		if wasSeated then
			pilotControlEvent:FireServer(Vector3.zero, false)

		end

-- Find nearest airborne obstacle for Mobile Soft-Lock Aim Assist
local function getAimAssistedTarget()
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local bestTarget = nil
	local bestDist = 500

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj:GetAttribute("IsObstacle") then
			local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(obj.Position)
			if onScreen then
				local center = camera.ViewportSize / 2
				local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y) - center).Magnitude
				if distFromCenter < bestDist then
					bestDist = distFromCenter
					bestTarget = obj
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestTarget
end

local function fireShot()
	if not currentWeapon or isReloading or not canFire or currentAmmo <= 0 then
		if currentAmmo <= 0 and not isReloading then
			task.spawn(reloadWeapon)
		end
		return
	end

	canFire = false
	currentAmmo = currentAmmo - 1
	updateAmmoUI()

	local handle = currentWeapon:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	local muzzle = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment")
	local origin = muzzle and muzzle.WorldPosition or (handle and handle.Position or Vector3.zero)

	-- Aim assist calculation
	local targetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
	local assistedTarget = getAimAssistedTarget()
	if assistedTarget then
		targetPos = assistedTarget.Position
	end

	-- Add small recoil / slight spread
	local spreadX = (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5
	local spreadY = (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5
	targetPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(spreadX, spreadY, 0)

	-- Fire server event
	weaponFireEvent:FireServer(origin, targetPos, mouse.Target)

	local fireRate = currentWeapon:GetAttribute("FireRate") or 0.25
	task.delay(fireRate, function()
		canFire = true
	end)
end

local function onCharacter(char)
	ghostFrame.Visible = false
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Tool") and (child.Name == "Pistol" or child.Name == "AK47") then
			currentWeapon = child
			maxAmmo = child:GetAttribute("MagSize") or 8
			currentAmmo = child:GetAttribute("CurrentMag") or maxAmmo
			weaponFrame.Visible = true
			if isTouch then mobileShootBtn.Visible = true end
			updateAmmoUI()
		end
	end)

	char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
		if child == currentWeapon then
			currentWeapon = nil
			weaponFrame.Visible = false
			mobileShootBtn.Visible = false
			isFiringAuto = false
		end
	end)

	-- Handle Death -> Ghost Spotter Mode
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if hum then
		hum.Died:Connect(function()
			ghostFrame.Visible = true
			tetherFrame.Visible = false
			weaponFrame.Visible = false
		end)
	end
end
